meta.title: PR Ageing Auto-Lock: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as the same Procurement Manager on distinct Growth and Enterprise plan tenants when their tenant identities are not provided.
Locate, configure, and apply PR Ageing Auto-Lock to lock PRs older than a threshold.
Verify that the capability is refused or absent on Growth and available and functional on Enterprise.
Compare the capability outcome across the two plan tiers.
